'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]], [[2023 Russian Christmas truce proposal]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] shell the [[front line]] city of [[Kramatorsk]], damaging at least fourteen homes, according to the city's mayor, with no reports of casualties. Meanwhile, [[Donetsk People's Republic]] officials accuse [[Ukraine]] of shelling [[Donetsk]] with [[artillery]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/russian-ceasefire-comes-into-force-in-ukraine (Reuters via ''The Straits Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64187704 (BBC News)]
***[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
****A Russian [[missile]] strike near a [[fire station]] in [[Kherson]], kills one person and injures four others, according to regional official [[Yaroslav Yanushevych]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3647652-russian-strike-on-kherson-fire-station-one-rescuer-killed-four-more-injured.html (Ukrinform)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[2023 Sinaloa unrest]]
***[[Mexico]]'s secretary of defense [[Luis Cresencio Sandoval]] reports that a total of 29 people, 19 gang members and ten military personnel, were killed during the operation which ended in the arrest of [[Ovidio Guzmán]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-says-least-29-killed-during-capture-el-chapos-son-2023-01-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least 20 people are killed and many more injured during an [[ambush]] by [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] [[insurgent]]s at a government base at the Hilowle Gaab village. [https://hornobserver.com/articles/1939/At-least-20-killed-in-an-Al-Shabab-attack-in-Somalia-Middle-Shabelle-region (Horn Observer)]
**Al-Shabaab gunmen storm a village in [[Hirshabelle State]] that was captured from the [[jihadist]] group last week, killing at least six people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/6/armed-fighters-in-kill-six-in-village-raid-in-somalia (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[2022–2023 food crises]]
***The [[United Nations]]' [[Food and Agriculture Organization]] reports that international food prices reached a record high in 2022 amid ongoing concerns of food shortages. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/world-food-prices-hit-record-high-2022-despite-december-fall-2023-01-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 16 people are killed and 21 others are injured when a bus crashes while travelling from [[Kampala]] to [[Gulu]] in northern [[Uganda]]. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/news/east-africa/uganda-bus-crash-leaves-16-dead-scores-injured-4077514 (''Daily Monitor'' via ''The East African'')]
*One person is killed and two others are injured when a crane collapses in [[Melhus Municipality|Melhus]], [[Trøndelag]], [[Norway]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/deadly-crane-fall-at-norway-shopping-center/a-64307047 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–China relations]]
**The [[Taliban]] and the [[Xinjiang]] Central Asia Petroleum and Gas Company of [[China]] agree to a 25-year deal to allow the Chinese firm to drill for oil in the [[Amu Darya]] basin. It is [[Afghanistan]]'s first major energy extraction agreement with a foreign firm since the Taliban [[2021 Taliban offensive|returned to power]] in 2021. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-64183083 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Saudi Arabia]], [[Censorship of Wikipedia]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] two [[Wikipedia administrators]] to 32 and 8 years in prison, respectively, in relation to their activities on the website. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2023/jan/05/saudi-arabia-jails-two-wikipedia-staff-in-bid-to-control-content (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*[[Toxic cough syrup]]
**State security police in [[Uzbekistan]] arrest four people over the deaths of 19 children who consumed a cough syrup product manufactured by [[India]]n drug manufacturer Marion Biotech last week. [https://www.rferl.org/a/uzbekistan-india-cough-syrup-deaths-arrests/32212368.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Interim [[President of Mali|president]] [[Assimi Goïta]] [[pardon]]s 49 [[Armed Forces of the Republic of Ivory Coast|Ivorian soldiers]] who were arrested in July and [[conviction|convicted]] of "undermining [[National security|state security]]". [https://www.voanews.com/a/mali-junta-leader-pardons-all-49-ivorian-soldiers/6908234.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[Incarceration of Ana Montes]]
**After serving 20 years in prison, [[Ana Montes]], a former senior analyst at the [[Defense Intelligence Agency]] in the United States, who spied on behalf of the Cuban government for 17 years, is released from the [[FMC Carswell]] in [[Fort Worth, Texas]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/01/08/us/cuba-spy-ana-montes-released-intl/index.html (CNN)]
